oneLiner: Transform raw status bullets into polished updates tailored for executives and teams
problem: Professionals waste time rewriting status updates in different tones and detail levels for different audiences, often producing inconsistent or unclear messaging across stakeholder groups
targetUser: Individual contributors, team leads, and project managers who regularly communicate progress to multiple stakeholder levels
coreFlow: Paste or type raw status bullets into input field
AI processes content and generates two distinct versions
Edit either version inline as needed
Copy to clipboard or export both versions

screens.name: Input Dashboard
screens.purpose: Primary interface for pasting or typing rough status bullets with optional context about project/team

screens.name: Dual Output View
screens.purpose: Side-by-side comparison of executive and team versions with clear visual distinction

screens.name: Editor Panel
screens.purpose: Inline editing capabilities for each version with real-time adjustments and tone indicators

screens.name: Export/Share Modal
screens.purpose: Options to copy, download, or share individual versions via email or collaboration tools

screens.name: History/Templates
screens.purpose: Access to previous updates and customizable templates for recurring status patterns

outOfScope: Direct integration with calendar or project management tools
Team collaboration or commenting on generated versions
AI model training on user data
